name: Wrike
summary: Work management for mid-to-large teams running cross-functional projects: reporting, workflows, approvals and resource management.
best_for: mid-to-large teams running complex, cross-functional projects that need robust reporting, workflows and resource management
skip_if: you're a small team that just wants a simple kanban board — a lighter tool is faster to adopt and cheaper
honest_knock: It's powerful and scales to complex, cross-team portfolios, but that power brings a learning curve and a per-seat cost that climbs — small teams often find it heavier than they need next to a simpler board tool.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month, for 2 to 15 users
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-25) A permanent free plan at $0 per user, with no user cap named on the plan card; Team $10 per user a month for 2 to 15 users; Business $25 per user a month for 5 to 200 users. Pinnacle and Apex publish no amount at all — both carry only a Contact us button and the line "Connect with us for pricing". Business and every tier above it is sold as an annual subscription only. Seats are bought in blocks: groups of five up to 30 seats, groups of 10 from 30 to 100, groups of 25 above 100. Self-service checkout covers Team and Business up to 15 users with no add-ons; beyond that the purchase goes through a Wrike representative. All prices are listed in US dollars and exclude local taxes.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 29 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We created a project with two made-up tasks, a custom field and two attachments, exported it to Excel and opened the Team checkout without entering a card.
findings: The trial is a 'free 14-day Pinnacle trial', Wrike's top plan, which has no listed price. It says you can 'continue on our Free plan' afterwards. The workspace came with a sample project already filled in.
Two tasks with a description and an attachment each took a few minutes. A custom text field was easy to add, but the value for the first row only stuck after clicking another cell and reloading.

The Excel export kept task names with accents, statuses, descriptions with quotes and line breaks, and the custom field. It did not include the attachments or Wrike's own task IDs; the Key column is just a row number.
The Team checkout started at 2 users with annual billing preselected: '$240 per year, before tax', which is the $10 per user a month annual price. The monthly price is $14 per user.
The invite dialog offers Admin, Regular User (preselected), External User, Contributor and Viewer. The plans page has a 'Get the Free plan' link, and the API app console is open in the trial.
not_tested: What the Free plan keeps after the Pinnacle trial ends
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
